results.title: Mistral AI Raises €3 Billion in Samsung-Led Round, the Largest Equity Deal in European Tech History
results.description: Mistral AI closed a €3 billion funding round Monday led by Samsung Electronics, the largest equity deal in European tech history, valuing the Paris-based startup at more than €21 billion. CEO Arthur Mensch said the capital will go toward building and owning data centers across France and Europe rather than relying on American hyperscalers — a bet that sovereign AI infrastructure is industrial policy, not just a compliance posture.

Kannababu, [...]VIJAYAWADA: Actor Chiranjeevi’s daughter Konidela Sushmita has been appointed as a special invitee to the trust board of the Durgamalleswara Swamy Devasthanam, popularly known as Durga temple, in Vijayawada.

The government issued a memorandum appointing Sushmita to the board.

Sushmita can advise temple administration

According to the memorandum issued by Endowments department secretary K. Kannababu, Sushmita can offer advice to the temple executive officer and trust board whenever required.

She can also assist the temple administration during major festivals and celebrations, the memorandum said.
